```lean
theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  let S := k
  refine IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_tower_bot K K S _
  exact Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_is_alg_closure K K (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_char_zero K)
```
